name: チームの一般設定パネル
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. LH09-0081 full team general-settings panel ONLY. Primary original full1/crop2 define exact original control anatomy, proportion, spacing, meaningful artwork/states; Japanese mock3 secondary text and localized team values. Portrait logical812x993 on pure-white canvas; no sidebar, watermark, global footer, added save button or toast.
Title「一般設定」Meiryo Bold20/28. Four sections with original compact airy vertical rhythm. Main labels Regular14/24; helpers Regular12/16. All cards/inputs white with fine pale-gray rounded borders. Utilities slate#526173. Do not bold all labels.
1 Two-row identity card:「アイコンと名前」left; original cyan-blue GLOBE artwork/pale-blue rounded square at60% width (preserve visible continent geometry; do not replace with mint initial); input「ライトハウス」right. Divider. Bottom「識別子」+ helper「作業の識別番号に使います」left, aligned input「灯台」right.
2「時間帯」heading; exact explanation lines「多くのメンバーがいる地域を設定してください。」「チームの時刻はこの設定を基準に表示され、」「作業の周期も指定した地域の深夜に始まります。」Below white control card left「時間帯」right closed neutral selector「協定世界時＋8時間・シンガポール」and original thin down chevron.
3「見積り」heading; exact explanation「作業の複雑さを共有し、周期内に残る余力を見積ります。」「チームが複雑さをどのように表すかを選択してください。」Below card left「作業の見積り」right closed neutral「使用しない」selector/down chevron. NO extra three estimation toggles, this source state has method NOT IN USE.
4「メールから作業を作成」heading; explanation「チーム専用のメールアドレスで作業を作成し、共同作業できます。」Below card left「メールからの作業作成を有効にする」right original OFF gray switch white thumb LEFT.
All content fully visible, source labels/states unchanged semantically. Neutral unfocused inputs/selectors, no green selected fill, no broad mint or shadows. Preserve all four sections and accurate muted/regular typography, no invented controls.
reviewNotes: All four Japanese sections/input values/+8 Singapore/method unused/email OFF and neutral controls checked. Source blue globe reappears but continent silhouette differs; some label optical weights remain heavy. Preserve pending artwork/type fidelity; static image does not prove setting runtime.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
